summary: scripts/st-test gives the megarepo member step a time limit (ST_TEST_MEMBERS_LIMIT, default 1200 s) and a file for its output, kills what it started when the limit passes, reads its ST_TEST_SIGN_JOBS and ST_TEST_MEMBERS_LIMIT settings before the seat environment scrub removes them, and lists as 'ran no test' only the crates the base does not list under no_tests

replay.detail: CI and local tooling only; no product code changes.

compatibility.detail: No product contract change. No signed content changes.
